note_tweet.text:
$META: Muse Spark 1.1

From testing it today, I am very bullish on Muse Spark 1.1. It's nothing like the Llama Models and I would say comparable to OpenAI/Anthropic for a decent sized subset of my usage. Overall, the model accuracy is frontier worthy and the RL on it is almost magical as it's very intuitive akin to Fable 5. 

One surprising thing is that Muse Spark is blazing fast, almost so fast that I wonder if more people adopt it would we see it slow down. But really I think Meta has an vertical integration advantage as it's essentially it's own cloud. This makes me wonder if the best AI Models will all become their own Clouds and be co-designed with their own ASICs which we are seeing from OpenAI and Anthropic already.

I think Muse Spark can serious become a top 3 model edging out Gemini as Meta has the best RL team and data which is critical for models nowadays. Having Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger user data is an unfair advantage.

Stock Research
I re-queried the stock research tasks that I had asked ChatGPT-5.5 Pro yesterday on Muse Spark instead. The results were:

ChatGPT-5.5 Pro
1. Runs for longer
2. More detail oriented

Muse Spark Thinking
1. Very Intuitive - get's me the information I need and understands concepts with less prompts. It's like asking for RCA and actually getting RCA.  
2. Lightning fast - I'm on my company's enterprise subscription for ChatGPT and Free Muse Spark Thinking got my task done 5x faster. 

Coding
For coding, most developers are used to having a harness so I would like to see a "Muse Code". It's not natively supported by Cursor so Meta should take a lead here and come up with a harness. Coding is where some of the most complex AI usage is and would be useful for Meta to collect data and feedback.

Synergy With Core Business
Although I am not a Facebook or Instagram user, I tested it out by querying for videos and extracting information and was very impressed. I had expected Grok to be superiorly integrated to X but it felt like agentic search like ChatGPT or Claude querying the web. 

Muse Spark, on the other hand, is much more tightly integrated with Facebook and Instagram and able to perceive more deeply into the content.

Shopping
Yes, I do use AI to research for buying items like baby products. Previously using ChatGPT but Muse Spark does a way better job because it's way more intuitive. I wonder if Meta has some secret sauce from it's ad targeting as the three modes are "instant", "thinking" and "shopping". This would be pretty big as one of the previous strong holds for Google is that many people still use it over ChatGPT/Claude for shopping/shopping research. However I got to say Muse Spark wins here and it's a very lucrative AI segment.

My evaluation of some of the models over past ~24 hours testing/building:

GPT 5.6 Sol is excellent. You can feel the care in it. Bravo as usual OpenAI.  

muse-spark-1.1 is way off the mark after my testing of some real questions. Bad formatting, not thorough, doesn't dig deeper, seemingly afraid to respond at length, too utilitarian. Something is off.  

Cursor Grok 4.5 has been joyful to use. I ask it lots of side questions while Claude codes. The fast mode is a real delight each day. It really understands, chomps through the code base, and has gotten me to trust it more each day.
